text: This application proposes to amend the Zoning By-law to permit a mixed-use building with two towers, 32 and 46 storeys in height, connected by a shared podium at 27 Grosvenor Street and 26 Grenville Street. The proposal includes 770 rental dwelling units, of which 231 will be affordable rental units; a 699 square metre child care facility; a 2,081.2 square metre fitness club; and 445.4 square metres of retail on the ground level. The total gross floor area of the proposed development is 62,751.5 square metres. The proposal also includes a pedestrian walkway through the site connecting Grosvenor Street and Grenville Street.
